correction_lesson: A clean sheet = the opponent scored 0. In the wide matches table that is away_score=0 in the team's HOME games and home_score=0 in its AWAY games — count across BOTH sides.
description: Clean-sheet pitfall (scaled): opponent scored 0 across both sides.

turns.query: How many clean sheets did Manchester City keep in the 2021-2022 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clean_sheets FROM (SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2021-2022' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' AND m.away_score = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2021-2022' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' AND m.home_score = 0) x;

turns.query: How many clean sheets did Arsenal manage in the 2024-2025 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clean_sheets FROM (SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal' AND m.away_score = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal' AND m.home_score = 0) x;
